accelerator.kernel_launch_overhead_cycle.source: Jeffrey Yu, compiler 2c1c1be: 96 cycles per vector pass measured on Sphinx. Reused as a reference assumption for other hardware.

accelerator.sa_output_slack_cycles.source: Jeffrey Yu, compiler 7df1cd8: measured range 20–40 on E4M3x16x16. Preserve the original subtraction of 24 from a cycle difference.

accelerator.spmm_row_cycles.source: Jeffrey Yu, compiler 2f0ae93: 7.3–7.5 cycles per row on Sphinx, rounded to 8.

soc.bank_switch_cycles.source: Jeffrey Yu, compiler ebbb003: 8-cycle Sphinx read round trip. This describes the Sphinx fabric model, not accelerator HLS.

soc.memory_request_latency_cycles.source: Compiler a9fa461: no extra per-request initiation cost. This is not SRAM response latency.

accelerator.cim.output_cycles_per_vector.source: Compiler a9fa461: one-cycle minimum service. Payload beat count and resource costs still apply.

accelerator.cim.accumulation_feedback_cy.source: No proven stall-safe feedback bound. Null preserves the existing unvalidated safety result; it does not assert zero latency.

accelerator.cim.weight_release_cycles.source: Compiler a9fa461 and CIMProcessor::set_scoreboard: one registered release transition. Extra HLS stages remain unmeasured.

accelerator.cim.weight_ready_cycles.source: Compiler a9fa461 and CIMProcessor::set_scoreboard: one registered ready transition. Extra HLS stages remain unmeasured.

accelerator.cim.output_bank_drain_cycles.source: Reference-only ideal model before the K128 correction. Zero omits bank drain; do not use this record to target hardware.

accelerator.cim.output_pipeline.source: No complete fused output pipeline record. Null retains architectural output storage with no added scheduled stages.
